description: Shell command injection via unsanitized user input to os.system
diff:
diff --git a/tools/runner.py b/tools/runner.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/tools/runner.py
+++ b/tools/runner.py
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+import os
+import subprocess
+
+def run_tool(tool_name, user_args):
+    # Dangerous: user input passed directly to shell
+    os.system(f"run-{tool_name} {user_args}")
+
+def generate_report(filename, template):
+    # Also dangerous: shell=True with user input
+    cmd = f"pandoc {filename} -t {template} -o output.pdf"
+    subprocess.run(cmd, shell=True)
+
+def safe_runner(args: list[str]) -> int:
+    result = subprocess.run(["safe-tool"] + args, capture_output=True)
+    return result.returncode
